newsitem.title: SPAIN: Jordan's king cuts short Spain visit after killings.
newsitem.headline: Jordan's king cuts short Spain visit after killings.

text.p: Jordan's King Hussein will cut short a visit to Spain on Thursday and put off a planned trip to Washington to return home after one of his soldiers killed seven Israeli schoolgirls, the Jordanian embassy in Madrid said.
"King Hussein will be returning home after the incident in Jordan. He'll fly home later today," an embassy spokeswoman told Reuters.
Hussein would keep his lunch appointment with Spanish Prime Minister Jose Maria Aznar, she said. Spanish officisls said the Jordanian leader would also meet King Juan Carlos.
The embassy said Hussein had condemned the killings and would release a statement later.
Spanish Foreign Minister Abel Matutues also condemned the killings and said the Jordanian leader had voiced concern about the peace process in the Middle East.
"Hussein, besides expressing his concern about the pace of the peace process, has asked the European Union, and Spain in particular, to play a greater role," Matutues told reporters.
Hussein was in Spain on a private visit. He had been due to travel to Washington for talks with U.S. President Bill Clinton on the troubled Arab-Israeli peace process.
A Jordanian soldier shot dead seven Israeli schoolgirls who were on a field trip to a site on the Israeli-Jordan border on Thursday.
